title: 1-D seepage section with fixed-head boundaries
description: Reusable SVG Darcy-seepage component for a homogeneous soil section with explicit upstream/downstream total-head boundaries, hydraulic gradient, Darcy flux, and discharge.
learningObjectives: Compute signed hydraulic gradient from stated total-head boundary conditions.
Apply Darcy's law to obtain specific discharge and section discharge without misrepresenting the result as a two-dimensional flow net.

verification.notes: Rebuilt as a real Three.js fixed-head seepage section with representative 1-D tracks; independent rendered comparison pending.
